question: The refusal census named 16 pages as 'needs geometry' and 12 as 'no clause understood'. Is the wall in the observation, or in the vocabulary that reads it?

protocol.experience: none - a fresh arm per page
protocol.fixtures: canonical/tests/fixtures/real_observations_20261116_v1.json (16 pages captured verbatim from the bridge)

answer: THE WALL WAS IN THE VOCABULARY, NOT IN THE OBSERVATION.

what_was_actually_in_the_channel.colour: every described box on click-color/click-shape/drag-shapes-2 carries its own fill
what_was_actually_in_the_channel.geometry: every element carries its box; the two boxes of drag-box differ by 4x in area
what_was_actually_in_the_channel.shape: the SVG tag distinguishes polygon / rect / circle
what_was_actually_in_the_channel.ranking: the boxes are enough to order a list and to say which is 'smaller'

evidence.why_it_was_refused_anyway: the compiler matched NAMES against a fixed list of operators. A description that was not on that list was refused, and the refusal was named after the wrong missing thing.

laws_measured.law: FILTER THEN PICK, NEVER PICK THEN FILTER
laws_measured.evidence: click-shape: the triangle is the 4th addressable element; picking first and checking would have failed on every page where the target is not first.

laws_measured.law: A COMPARISON IS AGAINST THE OTHER CANDIDATES, AND THE PAGE FRAME IS NOT A CANDIDATE
laws_measured.evidence: drag-box: the body is 480x210 and wins 'the larger box' by 30x until the moved element's ANCESTORS are removed from the pool. A thing cannot be dragged into the container it is already in.
drag-shapes-2 has two unfilled 70x50 boxes; the resolver returns AMBIGUOUS and the instruction's own word ('left') decides. Resolving by order would have reported a guess as a success.

laws_measured.law: NAME THE DIMENSION THAT IS MISSING, NOT THE ONE THAT IS CONVENIENT
laws_measured.evidence: drag-shapes says 'the black box' and the bin has NO fill: the page does not state the colour. Falling back to the page's own asymmetry is allowed only with the evidence recorded on the clause (PAGE_ASYMMETRY__FILL_ASYMMETRY).

laws_measured.law: A QUOTED NAME IS A NAME
laws_measured.evidence: click-dialog-2 regressed for one run because 'OK' was handed to the descriptor resolver and 'ok' is a size word. Quotes short-circuit the resolver.

corrections_made_to_merged_claims.claim: 'Click on the white colored box' needs pixels (REFUSED__SPATIAL)
corrections_made_to_merged_claims.why: the element's own fill is in the observation

corrections_made_to_merged_claims.claim: the 16 SPATIAL refusals were geometry problems
corrections_made_to_merged_claims.why: 5 remain genuinely geometric (angle, midpoint, freehand draw, colour wheel); the rest are described targets

corrections_made_to_merged_claims.claim: the wall diagnosis WHERE_THE_WALL_ACTUALLY_IS_20261116_V1.json filed 32 of 37 pages under 'budget'
corrections_made_to_merged_claims.why: an agent with 30 actions and no search now solves 43 of 130, including pages the 1500-action search failed on (enter-time, simple-arithmetic, text-transform, search-engine, use-slider). Search cannot find an action the vocabulary cannot express.

what_this_does_not_prove: It does not raise the ceiling of what is expressible. 44 pages are still refused and 12 of those need state that lives outside the observation (email, contacts, calendar). The number is capability on these pages, not a benchmark claim.
